title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.1 Add and Subtract Polynomials: Identify polynomials, monomials, binomials, and trinomials
summary: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.1 Add and Subtract Polynomials: Identify polynomials, monomials, binomials, and trinomials
body: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, section "6.1 Add and Subtract Polynomials", prints these objectives: "Identify polynomials, monomials, binomials, and trinomials" "Determine the degree of polynomials" "Add and subtract monomials" "Add and subtract polynomials" "Evaluate a polynomial for a given value". The section text says: "You have learned that a term is a constant or the product of a constant and one or more variables. The constant is called a coefficient. When it is of the form a x m , where a is a constant and m is a whole number, it is called a monomial. Some examples of monomial are 8 , −2 x 2 , 4 y 3 , and 11 z 7 ." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
